metadata.title: A machine-checked spectral floor for Pauli contextuality, and new configurations that attain it
metadata.description: Lean 4 formalization, for every number of qubits and arbitrary sets of Pauli observables, of the spectral lower bound on the contextuality degree first posted by B. W. Jonah (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23538829). The bound is attained exactly when a pure state has Pauli expectation values of one modulus on the set and zero elsewhere. New configurations of this kind outside the classical families, with exact contextuality degrees: 135 four-qubit observables with 1095 contexts (degree 75) and 496 five-qubit observables with 10880 contexts (degree 480), both proved in Lean, and 8128 seven-qubit observables with 2824192 contexts (degree 729344). The Pauli support of such a state is a two-character set. All flat states obtained from T, controlled-S and CCZ gates on up to five qubits are classified by exhaustive enumeration. Includes the Lean sources, programs, data and a demonstration on the Tsotchke stack. Research preprint, not peer reviewed. The research, programs, proofs and text were produced with an AI system (Claude, Anthropic) under the direction of the author, as disclosed in the paper.
